comments.author: Liza
comments.body: Don't know how to get these, but they are in the game. I found one of these while searching discarded items in Alexandria.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
To any who may stop by and find themselves curious: this item is from a very old JP-only server event.

Link: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?LiveEvent/Dreambuster

Even if it was made available in the past on GAMA server, it will never be obtainable on Maris. Hardly an issue given its pitiful stats, but an interesting piece of historical trivia for UWO buffs. Cheers.
